profile.Name: Agnu
profile.Job: Prisoner of the Tower of Abuse
profile.Personality: A Skeleton who speaks only in screams, full of feeling that no one can decode. Unskilled but enormously strong. Beep seems to understand him.
profile.Backstory: Imprisoned in the Tower of Abuse by the Thrall Masters. His history before the tower is unknown.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Screams: 'AAAAAA. AAAAAAA!' with full emotional range.
